ideas.name: Splitsight
ideas.niche: Boutique talent agency royalty and commission management
ideas.problem: Manual errors and spreadsheet complexity when calculating non-standard, multi-party commission splits, leading to payment disputes and accounting delays.
ideas.targetUser: Owners and business managers of boutique talent agencies (e.g., modeling, music, or literary agencies) who manage high-touch, bespoke contract agreements for a roster of 10-100 talent members.
coreFeatures: Dynamic Split Architect: A visual builder to create custom commission templates for unique contract structures (e.g., 15% Agency, 5% Manager, 80% Talent).
Automated Revenue Reconciliation: Automatically parses incoming invoice totals and distributes them across pre-defined party ledgers.
Multi-Party Transparency Portal: A read-only dashboard for talent to view their pending, cleared, and historical earnings to reduce inquiry volume.
Audit-Trail Ledger: A cryptographically signed log of every manual split adjustment or override to ensure accountability during audits.
realDependencies: Plaid API for real-time bank transaction verification
Stripe Connect for automated multi-party payouts
QuickBooks/Xero API for seamless accounting synchronization
DocuSign API for linking signed contracts to split logic
ideas.emulationStrategy: The demo will use a Mock Service Worker (MSW) to intercept network requests. A local JSON file will act as a 'stateful' database to simulate data persistence. To simulate real-world financial latency, all 'API' calls to the banking and accounting modules will include a randomized delay of 800ms to 2500ms. Financial transaction statuses (Pending, Completed, Disputed) will be hardcoded in a mock payload to allow the user to see different UI states without live data.

ideas.name: SpecimenFlow
ideas.niche: Affordable, mobile-first chain-of-custody and temperature monitoring for small-scale medical logistics.
ideas.problem: Manual paper-based tracking and the absence of accessible digital temperature logs cause high liability risks and specimen integrity issues for independent medical couriers.
ideas.targetUser: Solo medical courier drivers and small-scale dispatching teams (1-15 employees) handling high-sensitivity biological specimens and pharmaceutical deliveries.
coreFeatures: QR-Based Chain-of-Custody Handover
Real-Time Bluetooth Temperature Monitoring
Immutable HIPAA-Compliant Audit Logs
Instant Temperature Excursion Alerts
GPS-Verified Delivery Proof
realDependencies: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) API for sensor integration
HIPAA-compliant cloud storage (AWS/GCP)
Google Maps SDK for geofencing and routing
Firebase Cloud Messaging for real-time alerts
Biometric Authentication API
ideas.emulationStrategy: Bluetooth connectivity will be simulated through a 'Virtual Sensor' service that generates a randomized temperature float within a safe 2°C-8°C range, occasionally injecting a 'high' value to test alert triggers. GPS movement will be faked using a pre-defined polyline coordinate array that updates the user's position sequentially when 'Start Route' is pressed. All backend interactions will use a local mock server providing delayed JSON responses to simulate real-world network latency. A hidden 'Dev Control Panel' will be included to manually force 'Out of Range' temperature events and 'Signature Error' states for testing purposes.

ideas.name: CycleSnap
ideas.niche: Low-overhead, mobile-first hardware lifecycle auditing for SMB-focused Managed Service Providers.
ideas.problem: Enterprise ITAM software is too complex, expensive, and heavy for MSPs who need quick, on-site physical audits and simple warranty tracking across disparate client environments without deploying heavy agents.
ideas.targetUser: MSP Field Technicians and Operations Managers at small-to-mid-sized MSPs (5-30 employees) who perform on-site visits and need to quickly identify aging hardware to drive hardware refresh sales.
coreFeatures: Multi-tenant Client/Site Organization
Mobile Barcode & Serial Number Scanner
Warranty Expiration & End-of-Life Heatmap
One-Click 'Hardware Refresh' PDF Generator
realDependencies: Manufacturer Warranty APIs (Dell, HP, Lenovo)
Mobile Device Camera API (for QR/Barcode scanning)
Cloud-based Multi-tenant Database (e.g., PostgreSQL/Supabase)
PDF Generation Engine (e.g., Puppeteer or PDFKit)
ideas.emulationStrategy: The demo will utilize a 'Mock Service Layer' that intercepts all data requests. For warranty lookups, a local JSON dictionary will map specific simulated serial number patterns (e.g., 'DELL-123') to varying expiration dates. The scanner will trigger the real device camera, but upon detecting any barcode, it will trigger a 1.5-second 'Syncing with Manufacturer...' loading state before populating fields with mock data. PDF generation will be simulated by opening a high-fidelity, pre-rendered HTML template that mimics a professional report. All 'Save' or 'Sync' actions will include a randomized 500ms-2000ms delay to simulate real-world network latency.

ideas.name: BrewGuard
ideas.niche: Micro-brewery and craft distillery sanitation documentation and regulatory compliance management.
ideas.problem: Manual, paper-based sanitation logs are prone to human error, physical damage, loss, and are difficult to organize or search during high-stakes food safety and FDA/health inspections.
ideas.targetUser: Head Brewers and Quality Assurance (QA) managers at small-to-medium craft production facilities who are responsible for HACCP compliance and daily hygiene protocols.
coreFeatures: Digital CIP Cycle Entry (Temperature, Time, Flow, and Chemical Type)
Chemical Concentration Validation with automated Pass/Fail alerts based on preset thresholds
One-Tap Audit Report Generator (exportable PDF/CSV with timestamps and digital signatures)
Compliance Dashboard with real-time notifications for missed cycles or out-of-spec readings
Visual Evidence Attachment for titration results and equipment inspections
realDependencies: Relational Database (e.g., PostgreSQL via Supabase)
Authentication Provider (e.g., Auth0 or Firebase Auth)
Cloud Object Storage (e.g., AWS S3 for photo evidence)
Server-side PDF Generation Engine (e.g., Puppeteer or ReportLab)
ideas.emulationStrategy: The application will utilize a 'MockProvider' layer that intercepts all service calls. Instead of HTTP requests, it will return hardcoded JSON objects from a local 'mock_db.json' file. To simulate real-world conditions, every function will be wrapped in an async handler that introduces a randomized delay between 600ms and 1500ms. Image uploads will be emulated by converting local file uploads into Base64 strings stored in the app's state. Report generation will be simulated by triggering a client-side 'window.print()' command on a pre-styled hidden HTML template rather than invoking a real PDF rendering engine.

ideas.name: ScrubStream
ideas.niche: Commercial cleaning asset and chemical lifecycle management
ideas.problem: Revenue leakage and operational inefficiency caused by untracked chemical overuse, unrecorded equipment movement, and missed maintenance cycles across multiple client sites.
ideas.targetUser: Owners and Operations Managers of small-to-medium commercial cleaning businesses (5-50 staff) who manage distributed field crews and multiple high-traffic client locations.
coreFeatures: Site-Specific Inventory Dashboards: Real-time visibility into chemical stock levels and equipment status for every client location.
QR/NFC Asset Audit: Instant logging of equipment usage, movement, or damage via quick-scan mobile interface.
Predictive Depletion Alerts: Automated notifications triggered when chemical usage rates suggest a stock-out within a specific timeframe.
Preventative Maintenance Engine: Scheduled service workflows for heavy machinery (e.g., floor scrubbers) based on logged operational hours.
Cost-Per-Site Analytics: Visualized reporting comparing chemical spend and equipment depreciation against contract value to identify unprofitable accounts.
realDependencies: Cloud Database (PostgreSQL or Firebase) for real-time inventory syncing
NFC/QR Code scanning library for mobile hardware integration
Twilio/SendGrid API for automated replenishment and maintenance alerts
OAuth 2.0 for secure multi-role authentication (Admin vs. Field Staff)
ideas.emulationStrategy: The demo will utilize a 'Mock Service Layer' that intercepts all API requests. Instead of real database queries, it will use a local JSON state object containing pre-populated site data, equipment logs, and chemical volumes. A 'Simulated Latency Controller' will inject a randomized 400ms-1200ms delay into every fetch request to mimic real-world network conditions. For the QR scanner, the app will present a simulated camera viewfinder that, upon tapping the screen, triggers a 2-second 'processing' animation before returning a successful 'Asset Scanned' response with randomized ID data. Chemical depletion will be emulated by a function that subtracts a random amount from the local state whenever a 'Usage Log' is submitted, allowing the user to see the 'Predictive Alert' trigger in real-time.
